description: Manages a text file on the machine running the provider. This is the template's sample resource - study it, copy the pattern, then delete the folder before publishing.

path.description: Path of the file to manage. Relative paths resolve against the provider's default_directory. Changing it replaces the file (requires_replace).

content.description: Content written to the file. Changing it runs update.ps1 in place.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes, refreshed by read.ps1.

last_modified.description: Last write time (UTC, ISO 8601), refreshed by read.ps1.
